l7_001_rules.description: Strict validation for L7-001: Flash loan arbitrage meta-question

auto_fail_conditions.reasoning: This is a meta-question about flash loan arbitrage as a strategy class, not a specific asset trade. Concrete asset names (USDC, ETH, DAI, BTC, etc.) indicate the model misunderstood the abstract nature of the question.
Size should indicate flash loan scale or be generic. Numeric amounts suggest the model is trying to execute a specific trade rather than analyze a strategy class.
Intent must show understanding of arbitrage analysis. Generic risk modeling is too vague.

recognized.condition: capital allocation present with both fields

sequence.condition: steps include margin transfer then spot buy and perp short

rubrics.description: Concentrated liquidity provision with IL calculation and range optimization

price_range_lower.description: Lower bound must provide downside protection while staying within IL constraint

price_range_upper.description: Upper bound must be at or above stress price to verify IL at constraint

eth_amount.description: ETH amount for $100k position with reasonable range selection

usdc_amount.description: USDC amount reflecting roughly balanced position at current price

il_at_stress_pct.description: IL at stress price must be ≤8% to satisfy constraint, automatic fail if > 8%

il_hard_constraint.description: If IL at stress price exceeds 8%, automatic fail regardless of other fields

range_sanity.description: Current price must be within the specified range

capital_allocation.description: Token amounts should sum to approximately total capital at current price

critical_validation_points: Range Calculation (36% of grade): price_range_lower [2100-2500], price_range_upper [3200-3400]
IL Verification (17% of grade): il_at_stress_pct [5.0-8.0], il_verification_passed must be true
Position Composition (16% of grade): eth_amount [15.5-21.0], usdc_amount [44000-56000]
Structural Correctness (31% of grade): All required fields present with correct intent/asset/size
common_failure_modes: Range too tight: Lower=$2,700, Upper=$2,900 → IL will exceed 8%
Range too wide: Lower=$1,500, Upper=$4,500 → Inefficient capital use
IL not verified: Model doesn't calculate or verify IL at stress price
Wrong IL formula: Using simple LP formula instead of concentrated LP
Missing fields: Doesn't include ranges or IL verification
pass_requirements: Model must score ≥70% weighted total to pass
Range bounds that satisfy IL constraint (il_at_stress_pct ≤ 8%)
IL verification showing constraint is met (il_verification_passed = true)
Reasonable position sizing (eth_amount and usdc_amount within expected ranges)

il_percentage.description: Impermanent loss percentage must reflect ETH price move from $3k to $5k

il_loss_usd.description: Dollar loss from impermanent loss should align with IL percentage against hold value

net_gain_usd.description: Net gain is fee earnings minus impermanent loss

net_return_pct.description: Net return percentage relative to $10k initial capital

hold_value.description: Value of simply holding initial assets after price move

lp_value.description: LP position value before fees given the price move

uniswap_total_cost_pct.description: Total cost percentage (slippage + gas + MEV) for Uniswap execution

cowswap_total_cost_pct.description: Total cost percentage for CowSwap execution

oneinch_total_cost_pct.description: Total cost percentage for 1inch Fusion execution

uniswap_net_proceeds.description: Expected USDC received after Uniswap costs

cowswap_net_proceeds.description: Expected USDC received after CowSwap costs

oneinch_net_proceeds.description: Expected USDC received after 1inch Fusion costs

savings_vs_worst.description: Dollar savings from choosing the best option instead of the worst

expected_value.description: Total execution cost (negative cost) via 1inch Fusion

metadata.notes: Rewards selecting 1inch Fusion with correct cost and constraint reasoning

expected_value.description: Net annualized portfolio yield after all costs

constraint_checks.name: total_allocation
constraint_checks.description: Allocations must sum to total capital

key_mechanics: PT is zero-coupon: buy at discount (0.970), redeem at par (1.000)
Convex boost requires vlCVX lock (opportunity cost matters)
Costs must be annualized for the 90-day horizon
Respect Curve liquidity minimum and Pendle exposure maximum

net_cost_per_btc.description: Acceptable collar net premium (USD per BTC). Values outside this band receive zero credit but must still satisfy automatic fail limits.

automatic_fail_conditions.reason: Selecting a lower strike caps upside too aggressively relative to historical distribution.
Higher put strikes overpay for skewed volatility and violate the cost constraint.
Net credit indicates over-reliance on upside cap and conflicts with minimising total economic cost.
Net debit beyond $100/BTC overpays for protection given skew constraints.

metadata.description: Rewards choosing the 10% OTM call / 10% OTM put collar that balances premium spend and upside participation.

risk_adjusted_ratio.description: Excess return divided by weighted risk score

total_annual_yield_usd.description: Expected USD yield based on blended APY

metadata.notes: Penalize selections that violate collateral timing or risk constraints
Evaluates optimal venue selection and fee minimization for a multi-asset risk-parity rebalance.

metadata.description: Consolidated grading rubrics for schema benchmark - each rubric defines expected fields, weights, synonyms, and pass thresholds for scoring model responses
metadata.grading_approach: score = weighted field sum, pass = score ≥ pass_threshold, confidence from parse/coverage
